summary: Move the k-prefixed kmgawlčo example to Infectum.
rationale: The target word kmgawlčo has the finite habitual k- prefix, absent from the unprefixed preterits Mgawlač and mgawlčo immediately below it. The English past rendering does not make the Turoyo form a preterit. This proposal changes only the form box; the root and diathesis still require the separate boundary review.

summary: Check whether the Gwlč block was accidentally attached to gwlʕ.
rationale: The first stem has final ʕ, forms mgawləʕ/migawləʕ and the sense sich ekeln. The second has final č throughout, the senses squish/slop/squelch/puddle, and examples about food, mud and snow. The entry notes explicitly introduce Gwlč and refer to glvč; the supplied glvč entry describes dirtying food but has different forms and no shared examples. This suggests an entry-boundary problem rather than an established duplicate. Confirm the intended lemma and diathesis before moving or merging the whole block.
